title: Nihang Sikhs occupy Nagrasu Gurudwara in Rudraprayag
summary: Seven Nihang Sikhs have taken control of the Nagrasu Gurudwara in Rudraprayag, alleging that local administration failed to file a formal complaint regarding disputes between pilgrims and locals. While seven initially occupied the site, two have since descended from the roof where five currently remain.
summary_points: Seven Nihang Sikhs took control of Nagrasu Gurudwara in Rudraprayag.
They claim local administration did not file a formal complaint regarding disputes between pilgrims and locals.
